ability.name: Prism Armor
ability.note: Ultra Beast. In this Pokémon's first battle after moving to the field, its battle opponent's Gold Attacks become White Attacks. If this Pokémon is not affected by a special condition, any effects of the battle opponent's Ability that increase or decrease Attack damage are nullified.

wheel.name: Photon Geyser
wheel.note: This Pokémon may attach a Photon marker to the battle opponent. If this Pokémon has changed its form from [CTRL FID 498][Necrozma], it may attach the marker to a Pokémon within X+1 steps, where X is the number of Pokémon in the Ultra Space, instead of the battle opponent. The Ability of a Pokémon with a Photo marker is nullified.

wheel.name: Reflect Move
wheel.note: If there are any other [CTRL QL Ultra Beasts][Ultra Beasts] on the field, this Pokémon may move over its battle opponent and land 1 step away.

wheel.name: Prismatic Laser
wheel.note: *If the battle opponent is knocked out, the next turn will always be the other player's.
